title: Generators of the ideal-tensor kernel after localized base change
statement: Let $R,S,R',S'$ be commutative rings with algebra maps $R\to S$, $R\to R'$, $S\to S'$, $R'\to S'$ and compatible scalar towers giving the same map $R\to S'$. Let $I$ be an ideal of $R$, $J=IR'$ its image ideal, and $M$ an $S$-module with compatible restricted $R$-action. Suppose that $q:S\otimes_R R'\to S'$, $q(s\otimes r')=\sigma(s)\varphi'(r')$ (the product of their images), is localization at a multiplicative subset $W$. Put $M'=S'\otimes_S M$. Assume $(R/I)\otimes_R M$ is flat over $R/I$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $\theta:I\otimes_R M\to J\otimes_{R'}M'$ be an additive map satisfying $\theta(a\otimes x)=\rho(a)\otimes(1\otimes x)$, where $\rho:R\to R'$. Define $\mu:I\otimes_R M\to M$, $a\otimes x\mapsto ax$, and $\mu':J\otimes_{R'}M'\to M'$, $b\otimes y\mapsto by$. For every $z$ with $\mu'(z)=0$, tensor symmetry sends $z$ into the $S'$-linear span of the elements $\operatorname{comm}(\theta(k))$ for $k\in\ker\mu$ in $M'\otimes_{R'}J$. Here $S'$ acts through the first factor. No vanishing of $\theta$ on $\ker\mu$ is assumed, and no local, Noetherian, finite-module, or proper-ideal hypothesis is made.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00MO (lemma-another-variant-local-criterion-flatness), second and third proof paragraphs; Tags 00MM, 00MN and Remark 00M6, followed by localization exactness

proof.text: Put A=S tensor_R R' and N=R' tensor_R M. Tensor cancellation identifies S' tensor_S M with S' tensor_A N, hence with W-inverse N. The formula c' tensor (r' tensor x) maps to c' times the image of r' tensor x.

Write $K=\ker(I\otimes_R M\to M)$ and $K_N=\ker(J\otimes_{R'}N\to N)$, where $N=R'\otimes_R M$, $Q=R/I$, $J=IR'$ and $Q'=R'/J$. Apply the canonical surjectivity of Tag 00MM to $R\to Q\to Q'$ using the hypothesis that $Q\otimes_R M$ is flat over $Q$. Compose with the canonical surjectivity of Tag 00MN from $\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(M,Q')$ to $\operatorname{Tor}_1^{R'}(N,Q')$. The connecting-map descriptions of Tag 00M6 identify the source with $K\otimes_Q Q'$ and the target with $K_N$. The ideal $I$ annihilates $K$, since it annihilates the second-variable action on $\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(M,Q)$ and the connecting map is R-linear. Hence quotient tensor relations identify $K\otimes_R R'$ with $K\otimes_Q Q'$. Naturality sends $k\otimes r'$ to $r'$ times the image of $k$ under $a\otimes x\mapsto\rho(a)\otimes(1\otimes x)$. Therefore the composite gives a surjection with this generator formula. The existing Lean interface for 00MM will need its canonical-map characterization for this step; mere existence of an epi is not used as if it characterized the map.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00MO (lines 23953--23969), Lemma Tag 00MM (lemma-surjective-on-tor-one), Lemma Tag 00MN (lemma-surjective-on-tor-one-trivial), Remark Tag 00M6

proof.text: Use tensor cancellation to identify $M'$ with $W^{-1}N$. The multiplication map $J\otimes_{R'}N\to N$ is $A$-linear. Localization exactness and tensor naturality identify $W^{-1}K_N$ with the kernel for $M'$. The localized surjection from step 2 sends a generator $k\otimes r'$ to $\varphi'(r')\theta(k)$. Its value on a fraction is multiplied by the inverse of $q(w)$, an $S'$-scalar. Thus the localized kernel lies in the $S'$-span of $\theta(K)$, without assuming those images vanish. Tensor symmetry places the $S'$-module factor on the left.

theorem mem_span_ideal_kernel_localized_baseChange
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {R' : Type w} {S' : Type z}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R' S'] [Algebra R S']
    [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S']
    (I : Ideal R)
    (M : Type t) [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R S M]
    (hloc : ∃ (q : S ⊗[R] R' →+* S') (W : Submonoid (S ⊗[R] R')),
      (∀ (s : S) (r' : R'), q (s ⊗ₜ[R] r') =
        algebraMap S S' s * algebraMap R' S' r') ∧
      (letI := q.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W S'))
    (hquot : Module.Flat (R ⧸ I) ((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] M))
    (θ : I ⊗[R] M →+ (I.map (algebraMap R R')) ⊗[R'] (S' ⊗[S] M))
    (hθ : ∀ (a : I) (x : M), θ (a ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      (⟨algebraMap R R' a, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R R') a.property⟩ :
        I.map (algebraMap R R')) ⊗ₜ[R'] ((1 : S') ⊗ₜ[S] x))
    (z : (I.map (algebraMap R R')) ⊗[R'] (S' ⊗[S] M))
    (hz : TensorProduct.lift
      ((LinearMap.lsmul R' (S' ⊗[S] M)).comp (I.map (algebraMap R R')).subtype) z = 0) :
    TensorProduct.comm R' (I.map (algebraMap R R')) (S' ⊗[S] M) z ∈
      Submodule.span S'
        ((fun k : I ⊗[R] M ↦
          TensorProduct.comm R' (I.map (algebraMap R R')) (S' ⊗[S] M) (θ k)) ''
          (LinearMap.ker (TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul R M).comp I.subtype)) :
            Set (I ⊗[R] M)))
